input.answer: I'd go with Harel's "עוקב מדד S&P 500" track (קופה 13414). It's the S&P everyone at work talks about, Harel is a name I know, and it was near the top: 0.56% fee, "13.7%" over 3 years, "2.3 מיליארד ₪" in it. The fees all looked about the same, so in the end it came down to the name and it being S&P.

stuck.where: Screen 1, chip row under "במה הכסף מושקע"
stuck.why: There are 20 chips and I didn't know where to start. I noticed "עוקב מדד S&P 500 12" but the screens just kept going with the whole table under "הכול 143".

stuck.where: The table from screen 2 to screen 8
stuck.why: Row after row looks the same: אשראי ואג"ח, מניות, S&P, again and again for each company. Around screen 6 or 7 I'd stopped knowing which company I was looking at, because the company name only shows up once, in the grey bar.
I hesitated. The 24% looks way better and I believe the one that went up more is better, but I came for S&P, so I stuck with that.

stuck.where: Analyst "עוקב מדדים - גמיש" 26.39% and Meitav "עוקב מדדי מניות" 25.86%
stuck.why: Even bigger numbers, but I've never heard of Analyst and "גמיש" means nothing to me. It made me doubt my choice.

used: Heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות"
"קופת גמל להשקעה 143" chip, highlighted
Harel group bar: "דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%"
Harel row "עוקב מדד S&P 500": 0.56% מהחיסכון, 13.7% over 3 years, 11.92% over 5 years, 2.3 מיליארד ₪
Harel row "מניות": 24.04% over 3 years
S&P rows at Mor (0.71%), Analyst (0.56%), Meitav (0.6% and 0.58%) to compare fees
Company names in the grey bars: הראל, מור, אנליסט, מיטב
skimmed: The intro lines under the heading (2025, ספטמבר 2026, רשות שוק ההון)
The exposure column with the circles
Screens 7–8, by then I was just scrolling
skipped: The "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link
The ? icons by the column headers
Top menu (מדריך, השקעה במדד, חוקים וכללים)
unsure_meaning: "מט"ח" with a %: S&P shows "מניות 99%" and "מט"ח 99%", which adds up to almost 200%. I don't get it
"מניות 101%", how can it be over 100%?
"מההפקדה 0%" vs "מהחיסכון 0.56%": two fees? I guessed the first one is the one that counts
"פחות מ־3 שנים" in the return column, I guess the track is too new to have a number
"עוד לא דווח" with an orange ! sign
The rings' colours (turquoise and yellow): I guessed turquoise = stocks and yellow = מט"ח
The קופה numbers (13414, 8521…) with a little arrow icon
"לפני דמי ניהול" in the return header: does that mean I actually get less?
Tags "חדש", "הלכה יהודית", "גמיש"
"אג"ח", "אשראי", "מסלול"
not_found: No recommendation or "good for beginners" anywhere
No fee in shekels, e.g. how much I'd pay on 30,000 ₪
Nothing about putting in a few hundred a month, or what the first step is to actually open one
No button to join or open the fund

findings.what: 143 tracks in one long table where the rows look the same. Nothing tells you where to start, so I nearly closed it and did nothing.
Stocks % and מט"ח % add up to more than 100% (99% + 99%, 101% stocks). It looks like a mistake and I didn't get it.
Fees are only shown as small percents (0.54%–0.73%), so they all look the same. Nothing in shekels to show if the difference matters.
The company name only appears once at the top of each group. After scrolling I didn't know whose row I was on.
findings.where: Grey group bars (הראל, מור, אנליסט, מיטב)

findings.what: Two fees, "מהחיסכון" and "מההפקדה", and I don't know which one I'm really paying
The returns are "לפני דמי ניהול", so the big numbers aren't really what I'd get
Ring colours aren't explained next to the ring, I had to guess
"פחות מ־3 שנים" and "עוד לא דווח" with an orange ! look like a warning and put me off those rows
findings.where: Several rows, e.g. Mor הלכה, Meitav אג"ח ממשלתי

findings.what: Nothing on what to do next or how to actually open the fund
findings.where: Whole page as far as I scrolled
